BiblicalUsage: Punishment after examination is the meaning of this word, and it appears once, in the law of the bondmaid. In Leviticus 19:20, if a man lies with a bondmaid betrothed to another and not redeemed, she shall be scourged — punishment, but not death, because the case was examined and her standing was different. One word for a measured penalty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the examined punishment shows a God who judges the case, not just the act — and that is mercy inside the law.
